transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble with my work lately. 

I've been turning in applications and, like, research notes... and they just keep having these small mistakes in them. Just stupid things, like mislabeling an artwork date or skipping a question entirely. It's... kind of embarrassing, honestly. Because I always think I've actually checked them over before I hand them in. So, yeah. That's mainly why I'm here.
Do you find that you often struggle to sit still or feel like you are constantly on the go, even when you aren't working?
Um, no, not really. I don't think so. I mean, I can sit still fine. It's just the mistakes with my work, mostly.
When you catch these mistakes, do you feel an overwhelming need to go back and check your work over and over again, perhaps following a specific routine, to make sure everything is perfect?
No, not really. I mean, I fix them when I see them, but... I don't obsess over it or anything. I just want to get it done.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless, or have you lost interest in doing things you usually enjoy?
Um, no. Not really. I feel fine... just normal, I guess. I still like doing my usual stuff.
Outside of your work, do you find that you spend a lot of your time feeling excessively worried or anxious about various aspects of your life, such as your health, finances, or future events?
No, not really. I mean, I don't think I worry more than anyone else. Just normal stuff, I guess.
Do you often find it difficult to sustain your attention when you are working on tasks that you find boring or repetitive?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess if something is boring, my mind wanders a bit, but... I haven't really thought about it.
Looking back at your childhood or your time in school, did you often have similar issues with making careless mistakes or struggling to pay attention during tasks?

Um... yeah, I suppose. Even back in elementary school, my teachers would say stuff like... I had good ideas, but I'd forget to turn in worksheets. Or I'd just lose the instructions. I guess I missed little details a lot... my parents kind of had to check my backpack every night to make sure. So... yeah.
In your day-to-day life, outside of your work or school tasks, do you frequently forget to do things like keeping appointments, paying bills, or returning phone calls?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... I'll intend to do normal adult stuff, like... returning an email or paying a bill. Or getting groceries. But then... a few days go by, and I realize I just never did it. It just sort of... drops out of my mind, I guess.
